name: smu-elearn
description: Read-only access to SMU eLearn courses, pinned courses, weekly modules, documents, search, metadata, and downloads.

interface.longDescription: Preview SMU eLearn files for this week, a search term, an academic week, or selected courses. Review the matching files and local destination, uncheck unwanted items, then confirm downloads. Includes a course browser and local Edge SSO/MFA.
defaultPrompt: List my pinned SMU eLearn courses.
Show this week's new eLearn documents.
Find the Week 3 documents for a course.
